data.description: An introduction to retirement planning concepts and analysis with attention to designing retirement strategies to meet various client situations. Focus given to plans and approaches to meet retirement income needs while taking into account the dynamics of the household. Explore how values, behaviors and psychological factors influence retirement choices and financial well-being.
data.title: RETIREMENT PLANNING FOR FINANCIAL PLANNERS

data.description: Introduction to consumer finance covering techniques of personal sector cash flow, asset and liability management, life cycle financial planning, investment management, tax planning, retirement, and estate planning. Analysis and evaluation related to personal financial planning.
data.title: INTRODUCTION TO PERSONAL FINANCIAL PLANNING
